final: WITH g AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL HAVING SUM(cnt) IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT g.observstation, g.cnt, g.cnt*1.0/t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s WHERE share IS NOT NULL HAVING AVG(share) IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avgshare AS excess FROM s JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avgshare) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM k
